title: Ukrainian Strike Collapses Section of Kerch Bridge
detail: A Ukrainian attack overnight on Nov 17 caused extensive damage to the Kerch (Crimean) Bridge, the road-and-rail link between Russia and annexed Crimea. Al Jazeera reported that two people were killed and part of the structure collapsed. Zelensky later described it as a seven-phase operation. Details of the weapons used and Russian confirmation of the damage were not available at the time of this update.
